find: SAY: Throwing live sparks near dry brush, writing off sick ground that could still be mended, leaving hurt creatures to rot in the ditch.
replace: SAY: Sparks carried carelessly, sick ground written off when it could still be mended, hurt things left behind. That is the ledger I fear we are keeping.
why: The talk may not claim deeds the party did.

find: SAY: Aye, well, keep your boots out of the embers before you turn in.
replace: SAY: Right, well, keep your boots out of the embers before you turn in.
why: Tobin's drawl is West Country: 'Aye' became 'Right' (as in the R12 Incitement).

find: my eyes are still rattling from the rails.
replace: my eyes are still rattling from the crash.
why: How the Express crashed is not told.

find: and the next the whole carriage pitches into the ditch like an overturned hay-wain.
replace: and the next the whole carriage goes over like an overturned hay-wain.
why: No ditch: how the Express crashed is not told.

find: after flying through a baggage door.
replace: after flying through a carriage door.

find: SAY: Aye, well, when you are dropped in a strange orchard
replace: SAY: Right, well, when you are dropped in a strange orchard

find: SAY: Aye, even a field surgeon knows when to shut the ledger and save his breath.
replace: SAY: Right, even a field surgeon knows when to shut the ledger and save his breath.

replace: Goodnight, then, I will see you when the lanterns go up.
